fullPassage: The whole of human society operates on knowing the future weather. For example, farmers in India know when the monsoon rains will come next year and so they know when to plant the crops. Farmers in Indonesia know there are two monsoon rains each year, so next year they can have two harvests. This is based on their knowledge of the past, as the monsoons have always come at about the same time each year in living memory. But the need to predict goes deeper than this; it influences every part of our lives. Our houses, roads, railways, airports, offices, and so on are all designed for the local climate. For example, in England all the houses have central heating, as the outside temperature is usually below 20°C, but no air-conditioning, as temperatures rarely go beyond 26°C, while in Australia the opposite is true: most houses have air-conditioning but rarely central heating.

det.korean: ② coming → will come: know + 의문사절(when + 주어 + 미래시제 동사)
det.analysis:
✅ ① knowing: operate on + V-ing(동명사). 전치사 on의 목적어로 동명사 적절.

❌ ② coming: farmers know when the monsoon rains coming → know 뒤 의문사절은 '의문사 + 주어 + 동사' 완전한 절이 필요. coming(현재분사)은 동사 역할 불가. will come이 적절. ←정답

✅ ③ designed: are all designed for → 수동태(be + p.p.). 적절.

✅ ④ rarely: 빈도부사. temperatures rarely go beyond. 적절.
det.tip: 의문사절: know when S + V (완전한 절 필수)

✅ ③ designed: 집, 도로 등이 기후에 맞게 '설계되어' 있다. 적절.

✅ ④ opposite: 호주는 영국과 '반대'라는 맥락. 적절.

questions.passage: The whole of human society operates on knowing the future weather. For example, farmers in India know when the monsoon rains will come next year and so they know when to plant the crops. Farmers in Indonesia know there are two monsoon rains each year, so next year they can have two harvests. This is based on their knowledge of the past, as the monsoons have always come at about the same time each year in living memory. But the need to predict goes deeper than this; it influences every part of our lives. Our houses, roads, railways, airports, offices, and so on are all designed for the local climate. For example, in England all the houses have central heating, as the outside temperature is usually below 20°C, but no air-conditioning, as temperatures rarely go beyond 26°C, while in Australia the opposite is true: most houses have air-conditioning but rarely central heating.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ③ 날씨 예측: 인류 사회의 토대
det.analysis:
❌ ① Monsoon: A Threat to Farming
(몬순: 농업에 대한 위협)
→ 몬순은 위협이 아닌 예측 가능한 자연현상으로 서술됨.

❌ ② Climate Change and Infrastructure
(기후 변화와 인프라)
→ 본문은 기후 '변화'가 아닌 기존 기후 예측을 다룸.

✅ ③ Weather Prediction: Society's Foundation
(날씨 예측: 사회의 토대)
→ 근거: The whole of human society operates on knowing the future weather. 사회 전체가 날씨 예측에 기반하여 운영된다는 핵심 주장. ←정답

❌ ④ Heating vs. Cooling: A Cultural Gap
(난방 vs 냉방: 문화적 격차)
→ 영국/호주 비교는 보조적 예시일 뿐.
det.tip: foundation = 토대/기반

→ 본문은 예측의 '정확성' 문제가 아닌 예측의 '범위'를 논함.

det.korean: ① 몬순 예측에 기반한 농부들의 예측
det.analysis:
✅ ① 몬순 기반 농부들의 예측
→ 근거: 'This is based on their knowledge of the past'에서 This는 바로 앞의 내용, 즉 인도/인도네시아 농부들이 몬순의 시기를 알고 작물 재배/수확 계획을 세우는 것(farmers know when... they know when to plant... they can have two harvests)을 가리킴. ←정답

❌ ② 연간 두 번 수확 이유
→ 두 번 수확은 This가 지칭하는 내용의 일부이지만, 인도 농부의 예측도 포함하므로 부분적.

❌ ③ 영국/호주 주거 환경
→ 이 내용은 This 이후에 등장.

❌ ④ 인류 사회의 날씨 의존
→ 너무 포괄적이며, This는 구체적으로 농부들의 예측 행위를 지칭.
det.tip: This = 바로 앞 내용 전체를 지시
